Name: Maaseiah, the Ruler
Summary: Maaseiah the ruler, with Jeiel the scribe under Hananiah, numbered Uzziah's army for war.
KeyStory: The host went out by bands by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under Hananiah.
RelatedPeople: Uzziah, King of Judah; Jeiel, the Scribe
LifeLesson: Order in an army begins with faithful record-keepers.
